subject.title: [Bug]: agent --json returns pre-hook assistant text instead of finalized before_message_write output

question: What should `openclaw agent --json` return when `before_message_write` rewrites or blocks the final assistant message?
rationale: The bug is source-proven, but choosing whether blocked hook output becomes suppressed JSON, a structured blocked result, or documented raw output is a security boundary and public CLI contract decision.

options.title: Return finalized hook output
options.body: For rewrites, return the post-hook assistant text; for blocks, suppress raw assistant text or return a clear blocked/silent result shape with regression coverage.

options.title: Document raw JSON as intentional
options.body: Keep returning raw CLI output and explicitly document that `before_message_write` only governs transcript persistence, accepting the downstream policy mismatch.

options.title: Defer to hook unification
options.body: Leave this issue open until the broader outbound lifecycle-hook architecture selects one finalization seam across CLI, Gateway, and channels.

recommendation.title: Return finalized hook output
recommendation.body: For rewrites, return the post-hook assistant text; for blocks, suppress raw assistant text or return a clear blocked/silent result shape with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is the public CLI result contract, and the central CLI runner history points most strongly to this owner path.
